shots.prompt: A close-up of a glossy red ceramic coffee cup, steam rising gently, raindrops sliding down the window behind it, soft ambient light reflecting off the cup's surface.
The cup sits on a wooden table, rain streaking the glass pane above, a single coffee bean drops into the cup, creating a small ripple, warm glow from a nearby lamp.
Wide shot of the cup on the table, rain falling softly outside, a hand reaches in to lift the cup, steam curling upward, the cup glows warmly against the gray evening sky.
